scientific_integrity: Analytical proof and reproducible exact-symbolic, exact-rational, and finite numerical corroboration; finite comparisons are not universal proofs. Neither authorship priority nor independent external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Real square consistent systems, normalized independent row Gram with two clusters p<q, nonnegative within- and cross-cluster correlations and nonsingular Gram, stationary iid row selection. The optimized factor is the sharp worst-direction one-step conditional squared-error decrease, not exact annealed long-run mean-square exponent. Specialized prior exact treatments and independent audit may be unresolved.
title: Three-phase optimal sampling for two-cluster correlated Kaczmarz systems
